info.text:
Coca-Cola doesn't bottle most of the Coke you drink.
In 2025, 85% of its drink volume came from concentrate sold to bottlers.
Concentrate was 59% of its $47.9B revenue in 2025.
2025 operating margin: Coca-Cola 28.7% vs about 13% at the largest US Coke bottler, Coca-Cola Consolidated.
Sources: The Coca-Cola Company 10-K FY2025 and FY2025 earnings release; Coca-Cola Consolidated FY2025 results.
